description: A host with files left behind by an account that no longer exists. /var/lib/oldapp is owned by uid 4242 and gid 4242, and neither number appears in /etc/passwd or /etc/group; one file in alice's home carries the stray gid alone, so the uid and gid arms of FILESYS-0010 are exercised independently rather than always together. nsswitch.conf routes passwd and group to 'files' alone, which is what makes the absence conclusive: there is nowhere else an identity could be coming from, so the check may FAIL rather than declining. Every other FILESYS check passes here — the point of the fixture is ownership, and a fixture that also violated three other rules would not prove which check the FAIL came from.
